question:
**Select the word that is opposite in meaning (ANTONYM) to the word given below**

Amalgamate
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'** i.e.** 'Dismantle'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amalgamate** refers to combining or uniting to form one organization or structure.(एकीकरण करना)
 
• **It implies** the fusion or merging of different elements, entities, or groups into a unified whole.
 
• **Dismantle** means to take apart or break down into its constituent parts.(विघटन करना)
 
• This term is **generally used** when something that was put together is being separated or taken apart.
 
• This **term is the antonym **of "amalgamate", as it refers to the opposite process.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Dismantle'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Now, let's look at the options and their explanations:
 
 
• **Integrate:** Integration refers to the process of combining or bringing together parts or elements to form a whole. (एकीकृत करना)
 
• **Combine: **It refers to the process of joining or bringing together two or more things to create a unified entity. (जोड़ना)
 
• **Coalesce:** It refers to the process of coming together to form one mass or whole.(एक होना)
 
 

2f:T9d4,

The correct answer is 'Option 1'
